reckless.requirements: 3 Power, engaged with a metal target. If you are with an enemy, add 1 {Dm} to your dice pool. A flash of light emanates from where you touch the metal. In a moment, the item starts to heat considerably. If the affected item is held or worn, the wielder suffers 1 fatigue. As above, but the wielder suffers 1 fatigue each time a recharge token is removed from this spell. Add 1 recharge token to this card. The heat is intense enough that it ignites flammable objects it is in contact with. Suffer 1 fatigue. Suffer 1 stress.
reckless.name: Heat Metal
